mapper.sql: id, username, password, nickname, avatar, phone, role, status, openid, balance, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, password, nickname, avatar, phone, role, status, openid, balance) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{status}, #{openid}, #{balance})
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET password = #{password}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `user` SET balance = #{balance}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%m-%d') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM `user` WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY DATE(created_at) ASC
